# Data Source: identitynow_segment

Use this data source to look up an existing IdentityNow segment by name. The lookup fails when several segments share the name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_segment" "austin" {
  name = "Austin employees"
}

output "segment_id" {
  value = data.identitynow_segment.austin.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The segment business name.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the segment is active.
- `created` (String) The segment creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) The segment description.
- `id` (String) The segment ID.
- `modified` (String) The segment modification timestamp.
- `owner` (Attributes List) List with the segment owner. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `visibility_criteria` (Attributes List) The segment visibility criteria as structured nested attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--visibility_criteria))

<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Owner identity ID.
- `name` (String) Owner name.
- `type` (String) Owner type, `IDENTITY`.


<a id="nestedatt--visibility_criteria"></a>
### Nested Schema for `visibility_criteria`

Read-Only:

- `expression` (Attributes List) Expression of the visibility criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--visibility_criteria--expression))

<a id="nestedatt--visibility_criteria--expression"></a>
### Nested Schema for `visibility_criteria.expression`

Read-Only:

- `attribute` (String) Identity attribute to compare, for comparison operators.
- `children` (Attributes List) Child criteria for `AND` and `OR` operators, each with a nested `expression` (up to 3 levels). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--visibility_criteria--expression--children))
- `operator` (String) Operator, e.g. `EQUALS`, `AND` or `OR`.
- `value` (Attributes List) Value to compare with. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--visibility_criteria--expression--value))
